text: Following the November 1, 2024 Scarborough Community Council meeting, additional context has been advanced which, on balance, justifies reconsideration of this matter.

The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item SC17.7, titled 17 Bellehaven Crescent - Fence Exemption. 2. Directed that Item SC17.7 be considered at the next Scarborough Community Council meeting on October 22, 2025 and that Notice be issued in accordance with Municipal Code Chapter 447, Fences.
